完全倒装: 整个谓语提到主语前面的倒装:方位副词开头、here/there 开头、直接引语等场景。
方位/地点状语开头(Here, There, Now, Then, 地点介词短语)+ 不及物动词 + 主语|主语是代词时不倒装:Here it comes.|直接引语后:asked/said the visitor|表"也"的 so/neither/nor 属部分倒装(下一课)|完全倒装常用于描写,让画面先入眼
On the hill stands a lonely lighthouse.
column3: 山上立着一座孤独的灯塔。

完全倒装: Behind the counter sat an old clockmaker.
column3: 柜台后面坐着一位老钟表匠。

完全倒装: There's the receipt, said the cashier.
Then came the announcement everyone feared.
column3: 接着来了那个所有人都怕的通知。

# title: At the end of the pier ___ a small fish stall.
column4: 地点状语开头,完全倒装:stands a stall。

# title: Here ___ the results you asked for.
column4: 主语是 the results(复数),倒装后动词跟主语:come。

完全倒装: a narrow path runs|runs a narrow path|does a narrow path run|running a narrow path
column4: 地点状语 + 不及物动词:runs a narrow path。

# title: There ___ the last ferry of the day.
column4: There goes + 单数名词 the ferry。

完全倒装: said the guide|the guide said|did the guide say|the guide says
column4: 直接引语后常用完全倒装 said the guide。

# title: Which sentence keeps normal order (不倒装)?
完全倒装: Here she comes at last.|Here comes she at last.|Here comes the bus at last.|There goes our train.
column4: 主语是代词 she 时不倒装:Here she comes。
